<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="#1C1C1E">

    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/llStatusBar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@color/card_background"
        android:elevation="4dp"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="16dp"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvMeasureStatus"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="@string/drag_waiting_for_start"
            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
            android:textSize="16sp" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/contentContainer"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:paddingHorizontal="16dp"
        android:paddingTop="12dp"
        android:paddingBottom="8dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/llButtons"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/llStatusBar">

        <LinearLayout
            android:id="@+id/llSpeedDisplay"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:padding="12dp">

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tvBigSpeed"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="0"
                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                android:textSize="66sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tvSpeedUnit"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="@string/drag_speed_unit"
                android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                android:textSize="18sp" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/g_container"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:gravity="center_horizontal"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:paddingTop="6dp">

                <com.example.clinometer.GGaugeView
                    android:id="@+id/gGaugeView"
                    android:layout_width="118dp"
                    android:layout_height="124dp"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="2dp" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvGCurrentBig"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:text="@string/drag_g_current"
                    android:textColor="@color/white"
                    android:textSize="17sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:visibility="gone" />

            </LinearLayout>
        </LinearLayout>

        <LinearLayout
            android:id="@+id/llTimeCards"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:orientation="vertical">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="0dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:orientation="horizontal">

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/card0to100"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:layout_margin="4dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
                    app:cardElevation="2dp">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="match_parent"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:orientation="vertical"
                        android:padding="10dp">

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvLabel0to100"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/drag_label_0to100"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                            android:textSize="11sp" />

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvCard0to100Value"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                            android:text="@string/drag_value_placeholder"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textSize="18sp"
                            android:textStyle="bold" />
                    </LinearLayout>
                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/card0to200"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:layout_margin="4dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
                    app:cardElevation="2dp">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="match_parent"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:orientation="vertical"
                        android:padding="10dp">

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvLabel0to200"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/drag_label_0to200"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                            android:textSize="11sp" />

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvCard0to200Value"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                            android:text="@string/drag_value_placeholder"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textSize="18sp"
                            android:textStyle="bold" />
                    </LinearLayout>
                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
            </LinearLayout>

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="0dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:orientation="horizontal"
                android:paddingTop="6dp">

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/card100to200"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:layout_margin="4dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    android:clickable="true"
                    android:focusable="true"
                    android:foreground="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground"
                    app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
                    app:cardElevation="2dp">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="match_parent"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:orientation="vertical"
                        android:padding="10dp">

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvLabel100to200"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/drag_label_100to200"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                            android:textSize="11sp" />

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvCard100to200Value"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                            android:text="@string/drag_value_placeholder"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textSize="18sp"
                            android:textStyle="bold" />

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvRestartHint"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                            android:text="@string/drag_tap_to_restart"
                            android:textColor="@color/accent_blue"
                            android:textSize="10sp"
                            android:visibility="gone" />
                    </LinearLayout>
                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/card0to402"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:layout_margin="4dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
                    app:cardElevation="2dp">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="match_parent"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:orientation="vertical"
                        android:padding="10dp">

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvLabel0to402"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/drag_label_quarter"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                            android:textSize="11sp" />

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvCard0to402Value"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                            android:text="@string/drag_value_placeholder"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textSize="18sp"
                            android:textStyle="bold" />

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvCard0to402Distance"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                            android:text="@string/drag_distance_m"
                            android:textColor="@color/accent_blue"
                            android:textSize="13sp" />
                    </LinearLayout>
                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
            </LinearLayout>
        </LinearLayout>
    </LinearLayout>

    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/llButtons"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:padding="16dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent">

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/btnStartMeasure"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            app:backgroundTint="@color/primary_color"
            android:padding="12dp"
            android:text="@string/stop_session"
            android:textSize="16sp" />
    </LinearLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
